chunk:
description: |
  Canonical installation contract entity for construction/contracting integrations.
  Maps from: contractor portals (HD Portal — types 299A, 299B, 118),
             CRM (Salesforce), document management systems, construction ERP.
  Maps to: compliance systems, ERP job creation, customer records.
  Common synonyms: Contract (standard), Agreement (generic), Signed Doc (informal).

  HD Portal-specific contract types:
    299A — Standard residential installation contract
    299B — Alternate/addendum contract
    118  — Special program or materials contract

required:
  - contractId
  - jobId
  - customerId
  - status
  - contractType
  - signedDate
  - timestamps

properties:
  contractId:
    type: string
    description: Canonical contract identifier
    example: "CTR-2026-000565"

  externalIds:
    type: object
    properties:
      portalContractId:     { type: string, description: "Contract ID/document ID in HD Portal or source portal" }
      salesforceContractId: { type: string }
      erpJobNumber:         { type: string, description: "ComputerEase job number this contract maps to" }

  jobId:
    type: string
    description: Links to canonical-job

  customerId:
    type: string
    description: Links to canonical-customer

  contractType:
    type: string
    description: Contract form type
    example: "299A"

  status:
    type: string
    enum: [DRAFT, PENDING_SIGNATURE, SIGNED, COMPLIANT, NON_COMPLIANT, CANCELLED, SUPERSEDED]

  complianceStatus:
    type: string
    enum: [COMPLIANT, NON_COMPLIANT, PENDING_REVIEW, WAIVED]
    description: Whether contract meets all portal/regulatory requirements

  complianceFlags:
    type: array
    description: List of specific compliance issues found
    items:
      type: object
      properties:
        field:      { type: string, description: "Field or clause with the issue" }
        issue:      { type: string, description: "Description of the compliance problem" }
        severity:   { type: string, enum: [BLOCKING, WARNING, INFO] }

  signedDate:
    type: string
    format: date

  expirationDate:
    type: string
    format: date

  value:
    type: number
    description:
